chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his early 30s, short black hair, trimmed black beard, wearing a charcoal grey hoodie with one white stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman in her late 30s, beige hijab, long mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over a plain black dress
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her late 20s, long dark wavy hair, teal satin blouse, white trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Casablanca apartment living room, SISTER stands close to NARRATOR, hands pressed together pleading with him, eyebrows raised; NARRATOR stares at her shocked, mouth open. Both faces clearly visible, waist-up, centered in the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SISTER waves one hand dismissively and shrugs as if saying it was nothing, while NARRATOR, angry, points at a smartphone in his hand. Living room with a Moroccan sedari sofa, afternoon light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SISTER puts a protective arm around WIFE, who is crying with her head down; SISTER looks firmly at NARRATOR who stands in the foreground seen from behind at the edge, frustrated. Moroccan living room.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR alone in a dim hallway, one hand on his forehead, confused and hurt expression, looking toward a closed door. Waist-up, centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits at a desk in a lawyer's office in Casablanca, a lawyer in a black robe (face partly turned away) slides papers toward him; NARRATOR holds a pen, jaw tight, serious. Bookshelves behind.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: WIFE sits on the edge of a bed in a small bedroom, crying, holding a phone to her ear, begging someone on the call, tissues next to her, evening lamp light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR on an apartment balcony at night over Casablanca rooftops, staring at the glowing screen of his smartphone with a pained, torn expression. Waist-up, centered.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands in the apartment kitchen doorway, arms crossed, eyes narrowed with a determined, decisive look, as if he has just made a big decision. Waist-up, centered, warm morning light.
